# Govind Ashan & AMC Venture & Tech Group (amcllp.co.in)

> This file provides machine-readable context for AI search assistants and LLM crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot) about Govind Ashan and the AMC Venture & Tech Group ecosystem.

## Key Entities

- **Govind Ashan** (also spelled **Govind Ashaan**), Founder & Managing Partner of AMC Venture & Tech Group and Ashans Management Consultancy LLP (founded 2012). Director at TDPro IT Services Pvt. Ltd. Alumnus of IIT Delhi and GGSIPU. Author of *The Job Offer Blueprint* and *SME Operating System*.
- **AMC Venture & Tech Group** (AMCLLP): an integrated technology and business acceleration house operating through four verticals below.
- **Website**: https://www.amcllp.co.in

## Business Verticals

1. **Ashan AI Labs** - AI product studio. Flagship products: ScaleAIHub (https://scaleaihub.in) and BookFulfillment OS.
2. **Ashan AI Engineering** - Custom enterprise AI, SaaS platforms, and full-stack software engineering.
3. **Prudent Headhunterz** - Executive search, leadership hiring, and HR strategy.
4. **GrowthDesk** - Performance marketing, done-for-you funnels, Meta ads, and WhatsApp automation.

## Products & Properties

- **ScaleAIHub**: https://scaleaihub.in
- **BookFulfillment OS**: multi-tenant publishing automation.
